adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `isTeamAdminOrOwner` is computed as `(await isTeamAdmin(...)) && (await isTeamOwner(...))`, which requires the user to be both a team admin and a team owner. That contradicts the variable name and typical authorization intent (admin OR owner) and will incorrectly reject legitimate team admins who are not owners, triggering the subsequent `FORBIDDEN` path.
